title: Owned UI Resident Capacity
description: Explicit host-composition capacities shared across its exact native UI lifetimes. These are retained logical resources, not work grants, maxPatchBytes or a physical heap estimate. Zero is an intentional non-admitting capacity; no default is supplied.

maxResidentBytes.description: Every admitted page reserves its full 256-byte array, including partial pages, before allocation. The charge survives publication and raw-input acknowledgement until final page retirement.

maxPages.description: Maximum simultaneous reserved or allocated page roots, retained in the exact payload owner's strong roster.

maxOwners.description: Maximum simultaneous instance scopes, payload scopes and page handles, including each captured read alias. Every increment is checked before any ownership change.
